description: Add one of your customers to a multi-customer dashboard. The customerId must exactly match the value that identifies them in your own database, because it is what gets bound to :customer_id in every widget query. Adding a customer does not give anyone access; use add_customer_user for that. Subject to your plan's customer limit.

customerId.description: The identifier for this customer in your own data, for example the value in your orders.customer_id column. Must match exactly.

name.description: Display name for this customer, for your own reference.

name: add_customer
title: Add a customer
